title: MLEADERSTYLE R2010 attachment-field version gate

scope.operation: Restrict groups 271-273 to their documented R2010+ DXF versions and refuse unrepresentable pre-R2010 attachment data.

versions.AC1021: R2007: groups 271-273 omitted; nondefault attachment data is refused before publication.

scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.87 marks groups 271-273 R2010+; Autodesk's MLEADERSTYLE DXF reference documents the group roles and values.
scope.claim_boundary: Selected direct-writer version gating only; no whole-version MLEADERSTYLE or native annotation support claim.

implementation: Emit group 271 and nondefault groups 272/273 only for AC1024 or later.
Refuse nondefault groups 271-273 for targets below AC1024 before output.

evidence.input: Runtime-generated typed MLEADERSTYLE objects; no fixture files committed.
evidence.older_target_refusal: AC1021 with attachmentDirection=1, topAttachment=10, bottomAttachment=9 preserves destination and caller values.
evidence.retry: The same dx_iface retries at AC1021 after resetting all R2010-only fields; groups 271-273 are absent.
evidence.newer_target_output: AC1024 and AC1027 emit exact groups 271=1, 272=9 and 273=10.
evidence.default_profile: The version matrix confirms group 271 is absent in AC1021 and present in AC1024/AC1027; unset vertical groups 272/273 remain omitted.
evidence.matrix: ASCII/binary output covers AC1021 refusal/retry plus AC1024 and AC1027 explicit-field output.

remaining: Other MLEADERSTYLE version-specific fields and native semantics remain open.
